test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If A can complete 2/3 of a work in 60 days, then A will complete 1/5 of the same work in how many days?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete 2/3 of a work in 60 days

**Calculation:**

Since work done by A in 60 days is 2/3 part of the work

Let the total work be x.

The complete work done by A is

⇒ 2/3 × x = 60

⇒ x = 90

A will complete 1/5 of the same work

⇒ 90 × 1/5

⇒ 18

∴ The time taken by them to complete 1/5 of the work is 18 days.
